title: Interactive Gantt Roadmap
dataNote: `items` are groups, tasks, and row milestones in row order (nesting through `parent`; `collapsed` folds children; parent bars roll up from child `start`/`end`); `dependencies` link items with `fs` (finish-to-start) or `ss` (start-to-start); `markers` are chart-wide vertical milestone lines; `holidays` shade non-working days; `notes` attach to an item by `target`; `color` is a palette slot (`1`..`9`) or `#hex` and `colorKey` names slots. Positions are not saved: the page lays them out from dates and `zoom`.
